verdict.rationale: Slack documents Slackbot as a personal AI agent that responds to natural-language requests: preparing meeting briefs, analyzing reports, updating deals "just by asking", and routing work to agents. The official MCP server also lets AI clients search, send messages, manage canvases and lists, and upload files. However, the evidence is marketing-level and does not show that the core product can be broadly operated through natural-language commands. missing for 10: documented scope of which Slack actions Slackbot can execute from natural-language commands (beyond briefs, answers and deal updates), in-depth first-party docs for the natural-language command interface, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Slackbot is your personal AI agent in Slack that understands you and your workspace, helping you prepare for upcoming meetings, analyze reports, and create project briefs.
Update deals just by asking Slackbot
Route work through Slackbot. Coordinate work by routing requests to agents and get results delivered right back into your workflow.
your integrated apps can search channels, send messages, and perform other Slack actions through MCP clients
